request.deadline: 9-month delivery period from July 2026 to March 2027
deliverables: Audited bridge running on Cardano mainnet in both federated and SPO threshold custody modes under controlled access by end of Phase 1
SPO and dApp partner pipeline required for public launch
Public rollout and 24 months of operations deferred to Phase 2 in Q1 2027
request.what: Phase 1 of 2 funding to take Bifrost from working testnet to launch readiness, including hardening, security audits, formal verification, ecosystem and partner readiness, and stewardship/economic foundations for launch.

claims.claim: Bifrost is designed as a permissionless Bitcoin-Cardano bridge secured by Cardano's existing SPO ecosystem that brings BTC onto Cardano as a native Cardano asset.
The proposal requests ₳12,332,031, approximately $1,973,125 at 0.16 USD/ADA, including a 10% refundable contingency, for a 9-month Phase 1 delivery period.
By the end of Phase 1, Bifrost will be an audited bridge running on Cardano mainnet in both federated and SPO threshold modes under controlled access.
Bifrost is currently funded through Catalyst Fund 14 for ₳739,000 and is intended to prove the architecture end-to-end on testnet by August 2026.
The document states that Catalyst milestones M1 and M2 are done and approved, covering bridge architecture design and minimal testable smart contract and Watchtower happy paths.
Bifrost custody is described as distributed across 400+ Cardano SPOs weighted by delegation, with movements requiring a cryptographic threshold of SPOs representing the majority of delegated stake.
If SPO coordination fails, Bifrost is intended to activate a federated mode as an operational fallback.
Bifrost's smart contracts, off-chain tooling, and SDK are stated to be released under Apache 2.0 so anyone can audit, fork, run, or build on the bridge without permission.
The proposer claims Bifrost will have no bridge token, no founder allocation, and no built-in revenue claim for the founding teams beyond delivery compensation under this proposal.
The proposer targets 1,200 BTC TVL, about 600,000 annual transactions, and 3,000 fBTC-holding wallets by Q2 2029 as Bifrost's base contribution to Cardano 2030 KPIs.

summary: The anchor requests ₳12,332,031 for Phase 1 launch-readiness work on Bifrost, a Bitcoin-Cardano bridge by FluidTokens and Lantr Engineering, with many technical and adoption benefits asserted but limited independently verifiable evidence in the supplied text.
